name: assets_kind_change
description: GH #3902 / REQ-759 (assets C15 part 2), docs/assets/change-of-kind.md sections 2 and 8. The header of a change of kind document: a stock SKU becomes an asset card. Written only by module assets (managed type). document_id is the id of the versioned document of Letflow.Documents (decision 0056) that carries the state, the gap-free number (AKC) and the issued time: no number, status or posted time is stored here. org_unit_id is the issuing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7) and the stock side org unit. event_time is the time of the change, ISO 8601 with offset, stored in UTC. This document posts nothing and creates no card (REQ-760 does); after issue nothing of the header changes.
